integrity: Seven sparse top cycles are checked over the integers and exact group actions are reconstructed; self-review only, without external validation.
scientific_limitations: Only integral third homology and its automorphism action for exactly three unordered points on the Pappus graph; no lower-degree integral homology, ring structure, or general-family assertion.
A potentially relevant indexed same-object earlier finding was only accessible by abstract/summary; absolute priority is unverified.
title: Integral top-homology symmetry of the three-particle Pappus configuration space
